description:
A monitor arm is a sure way to boost the effectiveness of a home office setup. A good-quality arm not only frees up usable space on your desk’s surface, it aids ergonomics by allowing you to move and position your display/s for optimal comfort. Plus, a monitor arm makes your office setup look really pro.

The only catch is the price. Most monitor arms worth buying will cost close to $200, and heavy-duty arms capable of holding two large displays can be priced even higher. description:
Some websites help you get stuff done. Others let you watch a picture of a pug spin around your screen for eternity. The Useless Web is all about discovering more of the latter.

The site is basically a doorway to some of the weirdest corners of the internet. Open it and you’ll see one big “PLEASE” button. Click that, and you’ll be sent to a random website with little to no practical purpose.
